mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from a GEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from a GEO website audit can vary, but businesses typically start observing improvements within 1 to 3 months after implementing the recommended changes. Significant improvements in local search rankings and traffic often become more apparent over 3 to 6 months as search engines re-crawl and re-index your optimized content and local profiles. Factors like the competitiveness of your local market, the extent of the recommended changes, and the consistency of implementation all influence how quickly results are realized. Local SEO is an ongoing process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Businesses typically see initial results from a GEO website audit within 1-3 months, with more significant improvements appearing over 3-6 months, depending on market competitiveness and implementation consistency.
